notes: How each fixed refusal message in refusal_literals.json is shown (Decision 22). "text" replaces a message that read like a developer note with a plain sentence; "code" gives it a reason code and so the catalog sentence (an internal state the user cannot fix in the dialog, or a family such as "inspection stays with the provider tree"), with an optional field it is about; "keep" lists messages reviewed and fine as written. Every literal is in exactly one; a test fails for a new literal that is in none.

text.A large object is identified by its nume: A large object is named by its numeric OID, for example 16413.
text.ALTER cannot unset operator hash or merg: Hash and merge support, once set on an operator, cannot be removed by altering it.
text.An active PostgreSQL transaction is requ: A transaction must be open to prepare it. Start one first.
text.Autocommit is required for this maintena: This maintenance statement cannot run inside a transaction. Turn autocommit on and try again.
text.Definition must create exactly the quali: The definition must create exactly the aggregate you selected, with the replace option you chose.
text.Each statistics element has kind and val: Each statistics element needs a kind (column or expression) and a value.
text.LC_COLLATE and LC_CTYPE go together: Set LC_COLLATE and LC_CTYPE together, or neither.
text.PERIOD foreign keys require both local_p: A PERIOD foreign key needs both a local period column and a referenced period column.
text.PostgreSQL configuration reload failed a: PostgreSQL could not reload its configuration after ALTER SYSTEM. Check the server before retrying.
text.Privileges must match the native object: Choose privileges that apply to this kind of object, or ALL on its own.
text.Privileges must match the object family,: Choose privileges that apply to this kind of object, or ALL on its own.
text.RETURNS TABLE column name is unterminate: A quoted column name in RETURNS TABLE is missing its closing quote.
text.RETURNS TABLE needs (column type, ...): RETURNS TABLE needs a column list in the form (name type, ...).
text.Retained session must have autocommit en: This command cannot run inside a transaction. Turn autocommit on and try again.
text.Select CURRENT_ROLE without names or NAM: Use CURRENT_ROLE with no owner names, or NAMED_ROLES with at least one owner.
text.Select GLOBAL without schemas or SCHEMAS: Use GLOBAL with no schemas, or SCHEMAS with at least one schema name.
text.Select a native default-privilege object: Choose the kind of object the default privileges apply to.
text.Select a native object family: Choose the kind of object the privileges apply to.
text.Select grant/revoke/inspect default priv: Choose whether to grant, revoke or inspect default privileges.
text.Select native ndistinct, dependencies or: Choose at least one statistics kind: ndistinct, dependencies or mcv.
text.Select parameter grant/revoke/inspect: Choose whether to grant, revoke or inspect parameter privileges.
text.Select privilege grant or revoke: Choose whether to grant or revoke privileges.
text.Statistics operands and kinds require re: Changing a statistics object's columns, expressions or kinds means dropping and recreating it.
text.Stored/virtual generation cannot be conv: A stored generated column cannot be converted to virtual, or back, in place.
text.Supply NUL-free UTF-8 configuration/PEM: Supply plain UTF-8 text of at most 2 MiB, with no NUL characters.
text.Supply a scalar parameter value: Supply a single value for the parameter, not a list.
text.Symlinked PostgreSQL configuration/certi: A configuration or certificate file that is a symbolic link cannot be used.
text.TABLE columns belong to the return type: Columns of a table-returning function belong in the RETURNS TABLE clause.
text.Target index is not a partitioned index: The target index is not a partitioned index.
text.a USING expression goes with a type chan: A USING expression is only used when the column's type changes.
text.a cast has no alter: A cast cannot be altered. Drop it and create it again.
text.a cast has no alter; drop and create it: A cast cannot be altered. Drop it and create it again for another function, context or comment.
text.a foreign key names its referenced table: Write the referenced table as schema.table, for example public.customers.
text.a generated column needs genexpr: A generated column needs its generation expression.
text.a setting is a parameter name: A setting must be a parameter name, for example work_mem.
text.a subscription needs connection settings: A subscription needs connection settings (host, database, user, ...). The password cannot be set here; use a password file.
text.a table is written schema.table: Write the table as schema.table, for example public.orders.
text.access method is a method name: Enter an access method name, for example btree.
text.access method is an access method name: Enter an access method name, for example btree.
text.attcompression must be pglz or lz4: Compression must be pglz or lz4.
text.attidentity must be a (always) or d (by: Identity must be a (always) or d (by default).
text.attstorage must be one of p, m, e, x: Storage must be p (plain), m (main), e (external) or x (extended).
text.cast method is function, binary or inout: The cast method must be function, binary or inout.
text.check option is no, local or cascaded: The check option must be no, local or cascaded.
text.colconstype must be n (none), i (identit: The column's generation kind must be n (none), i (identity) or g (generated).
text.colconstype must be n, i or g: The column's generation kind must be n (none), i (identity) or g (generated).
text.context is explicit, assignment or impli: The cast context must be explicit, assignment or implicit.
text.contype must be one of p, u, f, c, x, n: Constraint type must be p (primary key), u (unique), f (foreign key), c (check), x (exclusion) or n (not null).
text.enable state is O, D, R or A: Enable state must be O (origin), D (disabled), R (replica) or A (always).
text.encoding is an encoding name: Enter an encoding name, for example UTF8.
text.fill factor is 10 to 100: Fill factor must be between 10 and 100.
text.fillfactor runs from 10 to 100: Fill factor must be between 10 and 100.
text.filter_mode must be ALL, LIMIT_TO or EXC: The table filter must be ALL, LIMIT_TO or EXCEPT.
text.generated_action must be KEEP, SET or DR: Choose KEEP, SET or DROP for the generated expression.
text.generated_kind must be s (stored) or v (: Generation kind must be s (stored) or v (virtual).
text.inline trigger code is an EDB feature; n: Inline trigger code is an EDB Advanced Server feature; a value is refused here. Name a trigger function instead.
text.jstconntype must be local or remote: Connection type must be local or remote.
text.jstkind must be sql or batch: Step kind must be sql or batch.
text.jstonerror must be f (fail), s (succeed): On error must be f (fail), s (succeed) or i (ignore).
text.language is a language name: Enter a language name, for example plpgsql.
text.length and precision are whole numbers: Length and precision must be whole numbers.
text.location is an absolute directory path o: The location must be an absolute directory path on the server host.
text.member kind must be OPERATOR or FUNCTION: Member kind must be OPERATOR or FUNCTION.
text.member number is invalid: The member number is not valid.
text.mode must be plain, concurrently or fina: Mode must be plain, concurrently or finalize.
text.operator strategy number is invalid: The strategy number is not valid.
text.origin is any or none: Origin must be any or none.
text.owned by needs both the table and the co: OWNED BY needs both the table and the column.
text.partition_type must be range, list or ha: Partition type must be range, list or hash.
text.persistence is logged or unlogged: Persistence must be logged or unlogged.
text.policy type is PERMISSIVE or RESTRICTIVE: Policy type must be PERMISSIVE or RESTRICTIVE.
text.provider is icu, libc or builtin: The locale provider must be icu, libc or builtin.
text.replica_identity is DEFAULT, FULL, NOTHI: Replica identity must be DEFAULT, FULL, NOTHING or USING INDEX followed by an index name.
text.rule commands are SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE: A rule command must be SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or NOTIFY.
text.search_path is a comma-separated list of: The search_path setting must be a comma-separated list of schemas.
text.sequence data type must be smallint, int: A sequence's data type must be smallint, integer or bigint.
text.slot name is lower-case letters, digits: A slot name may contain only lower-case letters, digits and underscores.
text.streaming is off, on or parallel: Streaming must be off, on or parallel.
text.support function number is invalid: The support function number is not valid.
text.tables list applies only to LIMIT_TO or: The table list is only used with LIMIT_TO or EXCEPT.
text.the category is one letter: The category must be a single letter.
text.the code contains a NUL byte: The code cannot contain NUL characters.
text.the delimiter is one character: The delimiter must be a single character.
text.the internal length is a whole number or: The internal length must be a whole number or -1.
text.the partition bound is FOR VALUES ... or: Write the partition bound as FOR VALUES ... or DEFAULT.
text.the schema restriction is a browsing pre: The schema restriction is a browsing preference kept on the server registration; it cannot be set here.
text.the trigger function is required (the ca: Choose the trigger function; the current one could not be read.
text.this pgAgent has no connection-string co: This pgAgent installation does not support remote steps.
text.type is composite (c), enumeration (e),: Type kind must be composite (c), enumeration (e), range (r), external (b) or shell (p).
text.valid until is a timestamp or 'infinity': Valid until must be a timestamp or 'infinity'.
